claim: When you pause stream delivery in Firehose, the source of the stream (for example Kinesis Data Streams or Managed Service for Kafka) must be configured to retain data until stream delivery is resumed and the data gets delivered to the destination. If the source is Direct PUT, Firehose retains data for 24 hours, and data loss could happen if you do not resume the stream and deliver the data before that retention period expires.

evidence.quote: When you pause stream delivery in Firehose, you need to ensure that the source of the stream (for example, in Kinesis Data Streams or in Managed Service for Kafka) is configured to retain data until stream delivery is resumed and the data gets delivered to the destination.
If the source is DirectPUT, Firehose will retain data for 24 hours. Data loss could happen if you do not resume the stream and deliver the data before the expiration of data retention period.
